item.title: Jefferson County holds car seat distribution
item.description: STEUBENVILLE, Ohio (WTRF-TV) The Jefferson County General Health District held a car seat distribution Thursday from 9am until 2pm. The event was free for Jefferson County residents with children under the age of 1. Parents and caregivers had the choice of either an infant carrier or a convertible car seat. They also received quick demonstrations on how to use the seats. [...]

item.title: Aliens love West Virginia, the state ranks #12 in US for abduction-style UFO encounters: Study says
item.description: A new analysis from CSB places West Virginia among the states where abduction-style UFO reports appear more often than expected.
